links.comparator_used: Single LLM response per query (single-draw action instability floor)
links.outcome: Per-action instability floor (rate at which the agent's action changes on identical re-runs)
links.effect: Majority-vote aggregation over five draws removes 39% of the instability floor, then the gain flattens; the baseline pooled floor was 8.7% of outcome-vignette cells.
links.tradeoff: Mitigation is only partial: the gain flattens and residual instability remains, attributed to heterogeneous per-cell rates. The five-fold sampling cost is implied but not quantified.
links.quote: Majority-vote aggregation over five draws removes 39% of it and then flattens, and a null simulation attributes the residue to heterogeneous per-cell rates, so replication mitigates without eliminating.

design_hint: majority-vote aggregation over repeated draws and per-action instability floor in counterfactual fairness audits
